title: High-precision Dynamical Masses of Pre-main-sequence Stars with ALMA and Gaia
question: Can Keplerian-rotation modeling of ALMA 12CO(2-1) disk emission combined with Gaia distances give high-precision dynamical masses of pre-main-sequence stars, and how do they compare with evolutionary-track masses?

what.value: Optical/near-IR photometry used for SED fits

evidence.loc: 3.2 Masses and Stellar Parameters from Evolutionary Tracks
evidence.quote: fitting optical and near-infrared photometry collected from the literature

external_data.citation: Vrba1989; Epchtein1999; Briceno2002; Ducati2002; Cutri2003; Monet2003; Zacharias2003; Torres2006; Robberto2012; Muinos2014; Henden2016; Bowler2017

evidence.loc: 3.2 Masses and Stellar Parameters from Evolutionary Tracks
evidence.quote: using temperatures collected from the literature (cite: Herczeg2014; Bowler2017; Manara2016a)

recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibration, phase-only self-cal, CASA clean spectral cube with natural weighting, 0.4 km/s channels

recipe.goal: Fit Keplerian disk model to visibilities
recipe.method: RADMC-3D channel maps (LTE) transformed to visibilities with GALARIO, fit in uv-plane with emcee; 14 free parameters
key_parameters: 200 walkers; ~5000 post-burn-in steps; autocorrelation time ~1000 steps; walkers with chi2-chi2min>44 discarded
assumptions: X_CO = 1e-4, mu = 2.37, vertically isothermal disk, Keplerian rotation, tapered power-law surface density, LTE

recipe.goal: Fit stellar SEDs for Teff and L*
recipe.method: BT-Settl models fit to photometry with emcee; Gaussian priors on d (Gaia) and Teff (literature, sigma 150 K)

recipe.goal: Map Teff, L* onto evolutionary tracks
recipe.method: Each post-burn-in sample mapped onto five sets of tracks to build mass and age distributions; compare with dynamical mass

recipe.goal: Test foreground extinction in DH Tau
recipe.method: Add Gaussian optical-depth absorption exp(-tau) per channel with 3 extra parameters and refit

answer_key.quantity: DH Tau mass with extinction model

evidence.quote: this new model does increase the stellar mass to $0.141^{+0.016}_{-0.011}$ $M_\ensuremath{\odot}$

not_stated_but_needed: Which channel range was used in each fit and exact channels excluded for DH Tau
Clean mask, threshold, cell and image size
MCMC initial walker ranges and burn-in length
Model grid sizes/RADMC-3D settings (photon count, image resolution)
Prior form for gamma, v_sys, and Gaussian prior parameters for extinction model
missing_for_reproduction: exact clean parameters and channel selection
score_reason: Public data and public code, with MCMC setup well described, but imaging parameters and many fit configuration details are missing, and compute is heavy.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data, public code, and numeric stellar masses with stated priors and method.
